sources.title: The Diophantine Equation 3x^4-2y^2=1
sources.inspected: Original theorem statement, existing repository's Pell substitution; publisher metadata
sources.assessment: Known theorem used explicitly; prime-source nonsquareness is an application
sources.limit: No inference about all composite primitive factors

sources.title: Square Lehmer numbers
sources.inspected: Definitions and recurrences pp.85-87; Section 3 standing hypothesis on p.87; rendered p.87
sources.assessment: Odd R standing hypothesis excludes R=8 and R=12 from later square results
sources.limit: No verification of every proof; no conclusion about other papers

sources.title: Squares in Lehmer sequences and some Diophantine applications
sources.inspected: Definitions p.47; Theorems R1,R2,1 on p.48; relevant displayed Jacobi formulas and references; rendered p.48
sources.assessment: Main square theorem requires (L,M)=(2,1) mod 4; ours is (0,3)
sources.limit: Quoted R1 is a different equation; original Rotkiewicz source remains unread

sources.title: Squares in Lehmer sequences and the Diophantine equation Ax^4-By^2=2
sources.inspected: Introduction, definitions, Theorems 1.1 and 1.2 pp.275-276; rendered p.276
sources.assessment: Main square results require (L,M)=(2,3) mod 4; ours is (0,3)
sources.limit: Not a full-paper proof audit; quotations of older Jacobi conditions differ from Luca-Walsh

sources.title: Primitive prime factors in second-order linear recurrence sequences
sources.inspected: Main theorem hypotheses; Sections 6 and 7; references; rendered p.18 of author PDF
sources.assessment: Main theorem's coprimality and c=2 mod 4 hypotheses do not permit our substitutions; no matching Mersenne-weight statement established
sources.limit: Broader odd-valuation assertion in Section 7 is a conjecture, not a usable theorem

sources.title: An elliptic curve test for Mersenne primes
sources.assessment: Precedent for norm-one finite-field mechanism in Lucas-Lehmer; different generator

sources.title: Functional Degrees and Arithmetic Applications I: The Set of Functional Degrees
sources.inspected: Sections 2 and 3: finite difference definitions, Lemma 2.2, functional degree, group-ring action
sources.assessment: Established framework for our operator argument
sources.limit: Does not establish priority of the particular quadratic-character application

sources.title: On multiplicities of interpoint distances
sources.inspected: Theorems 1.2 and 1.3 and convex-layer definitions; reinspection of a paper already in RESEARCH.md
sources.assessment: Displayed convex and convex-layer sufficient conditions do not automatically cover our whole geometric class
sources.limit: Does not clear other special-case work or establish geometric novelty

sources.title: Applications of Jacobi's symbol to Lehmer's numbers
sources.inspected: Claude reports full original pp.163-187; Codex inspected all 13 rendered spreads, focusing on definitions, theorem hypotheses, and primitive factors. Original Thms 2,3,4,5 and Q_k on p.181 were compared directly.
sources.assessment: At (8,-1), Thm 2 eq.(5) gives character +1 between coprime odd-index terms; Thm 5 excludes U_p=p*x^2. Thms 3-4 have different parameter hypotheses. No directly applicable theorem for our Mersenne criterion or general norm conjecture identified. Original symbol orientations match Luca-Walsh; Yuan-Li reverses them.
sources.limit: Bounded applicability review, not a verification of all proofs or a priority determination. Forward-citation coverage incomplete. PDF is not included in the repository.
